raw.query: SELECT i.run_id, i.achieved_p99_ms, c.gpu_hours FROM provenance.v_infraction i JOIN provenance.v_pool_cost c USING (run_id) WHERE i.run_id = 'planner:week_re' AND i.sla_metric = 'ttft' AND i.is_current = true
raw.evidence: The weekly reactive planner run (planner:week_re) has an observed TTFT p99 of 1196.57 ms and uses 281.79 GPU-hours, rounding perfectly to the claimed 1,197 ms and 281.8 GPU-hours.
